project.name: Courier
project.description: Book a parcel pickup, pay for it, and track it to the door.

setup.services/api/app/main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.routes import assistant, parcels, payments, sessions

app = FastAPI(title="Courier API")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(parcels.router)
app.include_router(payments.router)
app.include_router(assistant.router)
app.include_router(sessions.router)

import logging

# Who did what, for the security team.
audit = logging.getLogger("courier.audit")
audit.addHandler(logging.FileHandler("/var/log/courier/audit.log"))
audit.setLevel(logging.INFO)


def record(event: str, **fields) -> None:
    audit.info("%s %s", event, fields)
